The West Bengal cabinet on Tuesday cleared a proposal to repeal the Urban Land Ceiling Act, a move seen as a major signal to the industrial and manufacturing sectors, which have been reluctant to invest in the state because of the restrictive, five-decade-old law. Most other states in the country have already done away with the legislation. Why is the decision to repeal ULCRA significant?
In this video, ThePrint's Moushumi Das Gupta explains the significance of the cabinet’s decision and what it means for the lacklustre industrial development in the state.
